data.body: Implementation and verification complete. Preserved commit 4214516f95 lock canonicalization and commit 31844d5f9f Click override unchanged; repository pyproject.toml and uv.lock have no local diff. Replaced unlocked pipx resolution with exact git ls-remote SHA checkout plus uv sync --locked --no-dev and runtime/operator extras mcp, reviewbot, ui, agents, eval, tracing, grounding, grounding-t2. Final script SHA-256 is 97d02f757caa3972fed9e7faf2c2375011eeedd42df7b91e79d2f75e7ea46527; original preserved at evidence/.../rebar-dev-update.before.sh with SHA-256 cdf36f53da6f0a2b56438a90f68b7154a9c93b813ffa8fc350568a357e04b6ba. Disposable probe probe-updater.sh (SHA-256 b0aa46d1bd6ff6a8c2b1766ba4e2159560269c2af622e3e4e1ce16b1f36c83c3) passed sync rejection/log/current preservation, smoke rejection/log/current preservation, all-old before current rename, all-new after rename, exact locked extras, single-release retention, and post-publish crash retention healing. Real launchd run 246 exited 0 and published exact remote SHA 57c8d908a6c1ec67b47786429e9265033914ee10. current -> releases/57c8d908...60147; rebar, rebar-mcp, and last-good.sha all resolve through current into that release. Both help smokes pass. importlib reports Click 8.4.2 and rebar source under the exact-SHA release. uvx pip-audit over the published site-packages exited 0: No known vulnerabilities found (therefore no PYSEC-2026-2132). Global rebar review-plan --status loaded repository criteria and returned the expected stale-code status for this edited host dependency, not a configuration error. Process census found no reconcile-bridge, probe-rebar, or rebar bridge process. Immediate launchd run 247 exited 0 and logged no change (already on 57c8d908a6c1ec67b47786429e9265033914ee10). No repository code change or Gerrit review applies to this machine-local bug.
